overview: This table gives each character the shown words and spoken lines for preset chat in battles, lobbies, results, and customization.
description: Per-character predefined chat text and voice IDs used by battle/lobby symbol chat, result and situation-overview bubbles, and customize/profile chat shortcuts. Indexed by the EGameChatLabel on a ChatDataTable row, they supply a text ID that resolves through the active locale's ChatTextDataTable and a VoiceDataTable cue ID.

ID.simple: The name that connects a character to their preset chat words and speech. Changing it gives the character a different set.
ID.technical: FName primary key: the export declares ImportKeyField=Id and serializes the value as ID, and all 27 row keys equal their ID values. AGameDataTableManager loads the CharacterChatDataTable primary asset into CharacterChatDataTables (DTM +0x550), skipping a null table. AGameCharacter::ResolveDataRows (called by ApplyCharacterSetup) looks up CharacterDataTable::Id_CharacterChat directly here, with no chat override, and caches the first found row as AGameCharacter::ChatRow (+0x3E0); a missing/None id has no matching exported row, so the lookup fails and ResolveDataRows returns false. UI paths also search the same table array with the shared row finders.

Id_ChatText.simple: The words shown for each preset chat message, including greetings and Cursed Energy reports. Changing one replaces the words players read for that message.
Id_ChatText.technical: TArray<FName>; slot = GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Chat->ChatLabel) = static_cast<int32>(Label) - 1. EGameChatLabel::None is 0 (slot -1) and Invalid is 255 (slot 254); neither occurs in the exported ChatDataTable, whose 58 rows use labels 1..58 exactly. All 58 exported arrays are in that label order. Consumers pass the FName to SetTextIdOnly, ShowSymbolChatMessage, FGameChatMessageRequest::TextId or UGameChatListItemData::GetChatTextId. Battle-system, online-chat-message, result and situation-overview paths call IsValidIndex; customize/profile/tile views and ChatListItemData copy or index the array unguarded. Every distinct text ID in this table resolves in all 11 exported ChatTextDataTable_<locale> tables; this table itself has no locale variants.

Id_Voice.simple: The spoken line played with each preset chat message when that chat is allowed. Changing one replaces what players hear.
Id_Voice.technical: TArray<FName> using the same Label-1 slot. All four direct playback paths (battle system, situation-overview bubble, online chat message and result bubble) validate the slot before PlayVoiceById; no unguarded direct Id_Voice indexing was found. PlayVoiceById resolves the FName to a VoiceDataTables row and calls PlayVoice with the caller's character/sender index as the VoicePlayerArray slot, falling back to the first idle player when that slot is unavailable; the ID is not a cue string itself. In FStudioBattleSystem320, voice is gated by CanSpeakChatVoice, a valid Chat row, bPlayVoice (shown message or hidden Provocation/Respect), and absence of the speaker from the player's BlockedCommunicationCharacterIndices; hidden out-of-team non-provocation/respect lines are silent. For Label 0x21..0x23, shown level-report text and voice use the slot recomputed from the clamped cursed-energy level mapping (1=Low, 2=Medium, otherwise High). Every exported voice ID is non-None, unique within its row, and resolves in VoiceDataTable.

notes: Export contains one asset/shard and 27 rows; every row has exactly 58 non-empty Id_ChatText and 58 non-empty Id_Voice FNames. Each pair is parallel and in EGameChatLabel 1..58 order.

The eight paired directional *_Out labels (ComeForward_Out through LetsWorkTogether_Out) reuse the preceding label's text ID, so each row has 50 distinct text IDs but 58 distinct voice IDs; this is present data, not a lookup collision to normalize.

GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex(Type) = Type - 1 maps the 1-based EGameChatLabel enum to the arrays. None (0) gives slot -1 and Invalid (255) gives slot 254; the exported ChatDataTable has neither. The battle level-report path remaps labels 0x21/0x22/0x23 before doing both text and voice slot lookups.

Cached-row distinction: AGameCharacter::ChatRow is reused by battle symbol-chat playback, result bubbles, situation-overview bubbles, and the chat-list pointers set by visual-lobby, situation-overview and result views. Customize chat/select/tile/profile widgets and IntervalPvE instead query CharacterChatDataTables directly from CharacterDataTable::Id_CharacterChat; they do not use the cached ChatRow.

Data relationships: all 1,350 distinct text IDs resolve in each of the 11 exported ChatTextDataTable_* locale tables, all 1,566 voice IDs resolve in VoiceDataTable, and all 27 chat rows are targeted by CharacterDataTable::Id_CharacterChat. Several CN character rows point at CP chat rows; CN_210 has Id_CharacterChat=None.

No per-locale CharacterChatDataTable variants or additional shards exist in the provided export; locale selection happens downstream in the text tables. One indirect consumer, UGameChatListViewItemWidget::OnListItemSet, gives CP_270_UNIQUE_3 a special Japanese no-line-break/auto-size-20 treatment.

Runtime claims come from reconstructed C++ (many comments cite retail RVAs) plus the exports. No retail Blueprint graph or live-game evidence was examined; AGENTS.md states retail Blueprints contain no logic, and reconstruction alone does not prove byte-identical matching.

usages.detail: Loads CharacterChatDataTable into AGameDataTableManager::CharacterChatDataTables (DTM +0x550); AddLoadedDataTables at line 146 skips a null resolved table.
ResolveDataRows caches the row found by CharacterDataTable::Id_CharacterChat on AGameCharacter::ChatRow (+0x3E0); there is no chat-id override and a miss fails setup.
Uses the cached row with a valid ChatDataTable label to display text and play voice in situation-overview bubbles.
Battle symbol chat reads the cached row, bounds-checks both arrays, and remaps level-report slots from clamped cursed-energy level; team/mute gates control whether the message and voice play.
Online chat messages look the row up directly from CharacterChatDataTables and bounds-check text/voice by the Chat row's label.
Result-screen bubbles use the speaker's cached row for text and voice; SetupSymbolChatMessages also passes the player's cached row to the chat list.

SetChatContext stores the cached row pointer on each filtered ChatListItemData; GameChatListItemData.cpp:16 indexes Id_ChatText without a bounds check and GameChatListViewItemWidget.cpp:15 sets the button text.
Passes the player's cached row into UGameCommonChatListWidget::SetupChatList(0, Row), filtering items by bUseLobbyEnabled.
Looks the row up directly from CharacterChatDataTables for the interval character, then calls SetupChatList(1, Row), filtering by bUseBattleIntervalEnabled.
Direct unguarded lookup; copies Id_ChatText and indexes it by the selected Chat row's label.
Direct unguarded lookup; builds customize tiles from Id_ChatText, skipping rows with bUseBattleEnabled=false and LevelReport_Medium/High.
Direct unguarded lookup; refreshes saved command shortcuts with Id_ChatText[ChatLabel-1].
Direct unguarded lookup for profile chat shortcut labels, again indexing Id_ChatText by ChatLabel-1.
PlayVoiceById resolves the stored FName through VoiceDataTables and starts the cue on the supplied VoicePlayerArray slot (or first idle player).
Loads the language-specific ChatTextDataTable alongside the other text tables, which is how the stored text IDs are localized.
